diabetes.outcome: Self-reported diabetes label in the 2015 BRFSS-derived dataset; not future diabetes onset or blood glucose
diabetes.limitation: Not clinically validated. Test sensitivity at the 0.5 research threshold was only 13.6%. A negative class does not exclude disease. Do not map this score to normal, OK, doctor-needed, or treatment decisions. Stress is not modeled. No glucose value is inferred.

sepsis.reason: Held-out discrimination was inadequate (internal ROC-AUC 0.527; external 0.576). The fitted artifact is retained for research audit, but this interface does not issue individual scores.

kiosk.reason: This model requires first-six-ICU-hour medians from an adult ICU cohort. A kiosk or smartwatch snapshot is outside the training population.
